claims.text: THE CAPACITOR-STACK READING, MEASURED AGAINST THE SAME STANDARD. The board already records that the account attributes the claimed lift effect to a Brown patent 'filed back in the late 1950s/early 1960s' and that neither candidate patent claims anti-gravity. Both patents have now been opened and word-counted: across all six pages of US 2,949,550 and all six pages of US 3,187,206, the word 'gravity' appears 0 times, anti-gravity 0, levitation 0, electrogravitics 0. US 3,187,206 opens 'This invention relates to an electrical device for producing thrust by the direct operation of electrical fields.' IT IS THE ACCOUNT THAT REINTERPRETS ELECTROKINETIC THRUST AS LEVITATION, and the patents do not support the reinterpretation.

claims.sourceText: Disclosure Project Briefing Document, section 3.8.5, https://archive.org/stream/DisclosureProjectBriefingDocument/DisclosureProjectBriefingDocument_djvu.txt , 2000-12, read against the board's existing claims on thomas-townsend-brown for US 3,187,206 and US 2,949,550
claims.text: The account attributes the claimed lift effect to Thomas Townsend Brown. The 2001 testimony describes an experiment by 'Mark Stambough' that floated a plate capacitor at about a million volts 'in accordance with principles that had been described in a patent that was filed back in the late 1950s/early 1960s by a gentleman called Thomas Townsend Brown. Brown and another individual by the name of Dr. Biefield had done this, so this effect became known as the Biefield-Brown effect.' The direction of motion is given as toward the positively charged plate. The board's own record of both candidate patents is that NEITHER claims anti-gravity: US 3,187,206, filed 9 May 1958, opens 'This invention relates to an electrical device for producing thrust by the direct operation of electrical fields', and US 2,949,550, filed 3 July 1957, claims 'Thrust producing apparatus' operating by impressing high voltage between a body and an insulated electrode 'whereby to cause relative movement of an ionizable dielectric medium'. It is the ACCOUNT that reinterprets electrokinetic thrust as levitation.

claims.text: Stated inference, and it is the strand's classification of this cluster. The ARV account and the TR-3B account make the same move in two different directions: the ARV account takes a real document that claims one thing and reads it as claiming another, and the King citation takes a real document that mentions neither scalar physics nor gravity and offers it as proof of both. Neither is a dispute about evidence. Both are citations that have never been placed beside the documents they name.

claims.text: NEITHER PATENT WAS FILED BY OR FOR A GOVERNMENT. US 2,949,550 was assigned to Whitehall-Rand, Inc. of Washington D.C., a Delaware corporation; US 3,187,206 to Electrokinetics, Inc., a Pennsylvania corporation, by mesne assignments. Both are private corporations, and neither patent carries a government interest statement. On the sponsorship test the board applies to the Pais filings, Brown sits with the private inventors and not with the Navy; he is board material for other reasons, including his FBI file, and not because a government filed his patents.
